title: rubus fruticosus var. vestitus
intro: Rubus fruticosus var. vestitus, commonly known as the Himalayan black raspberry, is a variant of the black raspberry plant species. This plant is known for its dark purple, edible fruits rich in nutrients and antioxidants. The health benefits of Rubus fruticosus var. vestitus include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
